name: Halloween Dimension Egg
notes__en:
The Halloween Dimension Egg is the event zone's mixed egg. Instead of one pet it can hatch any of five, from the Candy Corn up to the Eternal Soul Phantom, with the Secret Pumpkin Golem in between.
The wiki does not publish the odds, so we can't say how often each pet drops. If you want one particular Halloween pet, its own egg (for example the Voidseer Pumpkin Egg) is the surer route; this egg is the gamble that can pay off with a Soul Phantom.
